about: The crypt's Well of mending (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB11): The fountain: a floating slab round a pool of healing in its middle that every hurt wizard standing in it draws on. Its edge a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall), sockets on its east and north and south and west sides for the bridges. tools/ground_shape.py draws crypt_fountain_ground.tscn and its art from this.
